user.title: DessMonitor Setup
user.description: Choose how this collector should communicate with Home Assistant.

hybrid.title: Cloud API + Local Telemetry
hybrid.description: Sign in to your DessMonitor or ShineMonitor account. Next, add local monitoring for faster readings. The cloud provides device information, settings, and backup readings.

data.company_key: Company Key (leave default unless specified by your installer)

data_description.username: Your account username on the selected platform
data_description.password: Your account password on the selected platform
data_description.update_interval: How often to refresh cloud fallback data. Local telemetry uses its own faster interval.
data_description.api_profile: Choose DessMonitor (default) for SmartESS or compatible rebranded apps. Choose ShineMonitor for SmartClient for Solar.

cloud.title: Cloud Connection
cloud.description: Choose DessMonitor or ShineMonitor and sign in with the account you use on its website or mobile app.

data.company_key: Company Key (leave default unless specified by your installer)

data_description.username: Your account username on the selected platform
data_description.password: Your account password on the selected platform
data_description.update_interval: How often to fetch data from the selected platform. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes).
data_description.api_profile: Choose DessMonitor (default) for SmartESS or compatible rebranded apps. Choose ShineMonitor for SmartClient for Solar.

local.title: DessMonitor Local
local.description: Read directly from one EyeBond-compatible collector. Home Assistant must have a fixed private LAN address. The callback request can briefly interrupt the collector's cloud connection.

data.local_redirect_confirmed: Allow Home Assistant to request local data from this collector

data_description.local_listen_ip: The fixed IPv4 address on this machine that the collector can reach.
data_description.local_collector_ip: The collector is pinned to this exact IPv4 address; other hosts are rejected.
data_description.local_expected_product_number: When set, a collector reporting a different product number is rejected.
data_description.local_tcp_port: The collector connects here; the default is 8899.
data_description.local_udp_port: Target port for the redirect command; the default is 58899.
data_description.local_device_code: Leave 0 unless a verified local tunnel code is known. The cloud devcode does not identify the local protocol. Existing SMG hints 1 and 2376 remain supported.
data_description.local_poll_interval: Primary status requests are serialized to protect the RS485 bus.
data_description.local_redirect_confirmed: Home Assistant sends UDP to this collector on port 58899. The collector must be allowed to connect back to Home Assistant on TCP port 8899. Check host and VLAN firewalls, allow only the configured private address, and do not expose either port to the internet. Depending on firmware, the request may briefly interrupt the collector's cloud session.
data_description.local_device_address: Leave 0 for automatic discovery starting at address 1. Set 1-247 to read only that inverter address. This does not change the address configured on the inverter.

init.title: Cloud API Options
init.description: The API remains the canonical source for identity, metadata, fallback data, and controls. Local telemetry uses its own faster polling interval.

data_description.update_interval: How often to refresh API metadata, controls, cloud-only fields, and fallback data. This does not limit local updates.
data_description.local_mode: Cloud only uses the API for telemetry. Prefer local keeps the API as the automatic fallback.

hybrid_local.title: Preferred Local Telemetry
hybrid_local.description: Local readings update the existing API-backed entities. Paste one or more collector addresses; each unavailable collector falls back to cloud independently.

data.local_redirect_confirmed: Allow Home Assistant to request local data from these collectors

data_description.local_listen_ip: The fixed IPv4 address on this machine that the collector can reach.
data_description.local_collector_ips: Enter one or more fixed private addresses separated by commas, spaces, or new lines. Each connection is pinned to its exact address.
data_description.local_poll_interval: How often to read local inverter telemetry. Five seconds is recommended and is independent of the cloud API interval.
data_description.local_redirect_confirmed: Home Assistant sends UDP to the listed collectors on port 58899. Each collector must be allowed to connect back to Home Assistant on TCP port 8899. Check host and VLAN firewalls, allow only the configured private addresses, and do not expose either port to the internet. API fallback remains enabled.
data_description.local_device_address: Leave 0 for automatic discovery starting at address 1. Set 1-247 to read only that inverter address. This does not change the address configured on the inverter.

data_description.local_poll_interval: How often to poll primary inverter status.
data_description.local_device_address: Leave 0 for automatic discovery starting at address 1. Set 1-247 to read only that inverter address. This does not change the address configured on the inverter.
